QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] The Corrupted Grandmaster
QuestInfo.1: Jack says he was attacked by corrupted Grandmasters while he was investigating the keep, and that during his escape, he wrote down the symbols they were exchanging with each other. Ask John about what the symbols could mean.
QuestInfo.2: You brought a letter containing the symbols Jack copied back to his brother John.

npc.0: Those symbols are the biggest clue we've got. With John's expertise in ancient languages, he's just the playmaker we need right now.
